run.machines: Lambda Cloud: m1, m2 NVIDIA Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB, m5 RTX A6000 48 GB; m3, m4 Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB for the failure test only; Ubuntu 22.04; one private network
run.workload: about 1,250 prompt and 200 completion tokens per chat request
run.telemetry: off on every router and node

failure.what: 4 machines, 8 concurrent qwen3-coder:30b for 240 s, 3 repetitions; a script on the router machine stopped Ollama on m3 60 s after the run's start line, then 90 s later killed herd-node with -9 and stopped Ollama on m4 (events: seconds from the run clock's zero; kill times logged on the machines, to the millisecond)

mixed_fleet.what: m1, m2 (24 GB) and m5 (48 GB); qwen3-coder:30b, qwen2.5:14b-instruct-q8_0, phi4:14b-q8_0 and qwen2.5:32b-instruct-q8_0 (35 GB, only m5 has it and can hold it), model chosen at random per request, open loop at 0.25 requests/s for 180 s, client timeout 300 s; start state m1 coder, m2 qwen2.5:14b, m5 the 32b; repetitions 1-3 are seeds 7, 11, 13, the same seeds for every front door

one_large_vs_two_small.what: one RTX A6000 48 GB against two Quadro RTX 6000 24 GB, each behind its own router; mix = qwen3-coder:30b, qwen3.5:9b and nomic-embed-text, 4 workers each, 180 s; 3 repetitions

vision.what: qwen3-coder:30b, nomic-embed-text and moondream (an image question per request), 4 workers each, 180 s; one RTX 6000 with all three loaded, against m1, m2 and m5; 3 repetitions
